What is the etymology of the name Apollo?
questions.answer: The etymology of the name is uncertain; the spelling Ἀπόλλων had almost superseded all other forms by the beginning of the common era, but the Doric form Apellon is more archaic, derived from an earlier *Ἀπέλjων. It probably is a cognate to the Doric month Apellaios and the offerings apellaia at the initiation of the young men during the family-festival apellai. According to some scholars the words are derived from the Doric word apella, which originally meant 'wall,' 'fence for animals' and later 'assembly within the limits of the square.'
